nodes.name: comment-robustness
nodes.summary: Harden the op walk and comment resolution
nodes.body:
The op walk's limit now counts op entries, not data-ref commits —
comment-only commits share the chain and must never crowd the newest
op out of the window (undo would falsely report no operations).
Comment ids are format-checked before lookup, and resolving a change
by name fails loudly when two applies used the same node name.

nodes.name: parser-hardening
nodes.summary: Make the diff parser count-driven and unambiguous
nodes.body:
Hunk bodies now consume exactly the line counts the header declares:
prefix sniffing misread removed `-- comment` lines (SQL/Lua/Haskell)
as file headers and silently truncated hunks. Paths come from the
`---`/`+++` lines (the `diff --git` heuristic breaks on paths
containing " b/"), submodule gitlinks degrade to whole-file units
instead of crashing analysis with E900, and Isomer-Change trailers
parse only from the final message paragraph, per git semantics.
Found by adversarial self-review.

nodes.name: replay-created-files
nodes.summary: Track created files so truncation is not deletion
nodes.body:
A stack that creates a file and later truncates it to empty was
unreorganizable: the replay classified the empty end state as
"deleted" and every plan — including the identity plan — failed E040
against head. Replay now records that a line hunk touched the file,
so created-then-emptied files materialize as empty files.

nodes.name: plan-hygiene
nodes.summary: Enforce message hygiene in check; commit via stdin
nodes.body:
R4 rejects multi-line summaries, NUL bytes, and Isomer-Change lines
smuggled into summary/body — the latter passed check, then corrupted
identity parsing on the materialized commit. The commit message now
reaches commit-tree via stdin: -m in argv died on ARG_MAX for large
bodies after check had promised success. SKILL.md documents the new
rules for plan-writing agents.

nodes.name: engine-identity
nodes.summary: Inherit identity only with whole-commit ownership
nodes.body:
Splitting a trailer-bearing commit into two nodes stamped the SAME
Isomer-Change id on both halves — the very next inspect flagged
duplicate_id on ism's own output and the change metadata was
clobbered last-writer-wins. A node now inherits identity only when
it owns every hunk of its single source commit (and never an id
another node claims explicitly). Also: an explicit-base apply no
longer clobbers the recorded trunk with an empty string, and a
failed void append no longer masks the E101 the caller must see.

nodes.name: rust-regression-suite
nodes.summary: Lock the review fixes in end-to-end tests
nodes.body:
Five new E2E scenarios: splitting a commit mints fresh distinct ids;
a gitlink-only stack reorganizes as whole-file units; a created-then-
truncated file survives the identity plan; plan-hygiene rejections
are E001; and `-- comment` content lines round-trip bit-for-bit.

nodes.name: app-main-hardening
nodes.summary: Desktop main: parser, exec, pty and bridge fixes
nodes.body:
porcelain=v2 rename records carry a score field and deliver the
original path as the next NUL record — the parser consumed the score
as the path and could misread the continuation as a new entry;
unmerged records are now read too. git log trailers unfold with an
explicit separator (folded values split records; multiple trailers
fused into a bogus id). Spawn failures in GitService resolve to
Result errors instead of unhandled rejections crossing IPC; exec
decodes output once (per-chunk decoding tore multi-byte UTF-8);
pty:create failures surface as structured errors; the preload bridge
enforces the channel allowlist at runtime; pty sessions are reaped
when the last window closes; smoke mode fails fast on load errors.
Found by adversarial self-review.

nodes.name: app-renderer-hardening
nodes.summary: Desktop renderer: race and lifecycle fixes
nodes.body:
Project data loads are guarded against switches mid-flight (slow
responses no longer land on the wrong project); the terminal drawer
subscribes before creating its session and buffers early output (the
shell's first prompt could be lost), kills sessions that resolve
after unmount, and surfaces pty errors; an untracked commit no longer
shows every comment in the project; the UI language loads from
persisted settings before first paint.

nodes.name: app-packaging
nodes.summary: Ship only node-pty in runtime dependencies
nodes.body:
Everything the renderer imports is bundled by vite; keeping it in
dependencies only bloats the packaged app under electron-builder's
file list. The lockfile keeps public-registry URLs throughout.

nodes.name: docs-sync
nodes.summary: Sync README and CLAUDE.md with the current surface
nodes.body:
The CLI is no longer "seven commands": comments, the embedded skill
and the desktop scaffold are real. CLAUDE.md gains the comment module
and the app's build/test commands, plus the no-second-channel rule.
